name: Alexander Meigs Haig Papers
description: The 1981 and 1982 Day File contains records used by FRUS editors to document U.S. policy toward the Soviet Union.
citation: FRUS 1981-1988, III, Soviet Union, January 1981-January 1983: Sources
exercise: Find the Department of State series and the 1981-1982 Day File. Preserve the container, folder and document date; check current access with the Library.

name: Henry A. Kissinger Papers, Part I
description: Chronological, geopolitical, conversation and telephone files used by FRUS editors.
exercise: Compare a memorandum of conversation with a telephone record. Check current access with the Library.

name: William D. Leahy Papers
description: The diary is cited in FRUS documentation of early postwar intelligence organization.
citation: FRUS 1945-1950, Emergence of the Intelligence Establishment, document 188, note 2
exercise: Trace the diary entries for February 12 and 17, 1947; record the date and page.

name: Cordell Hull Papers
description: Hull papers are identified among the sources for the Washington and Quebec conferences.
citation: FRUS, Conferences at Washington and Quebec, 1943: Introduction
exercise: Keep the personal-paper citation separate from the State Department copy.

name: Senate Foreign Relations Committee records
description: FRUS lists these Senate committee records among its archival sources.
citation: FRUS 1969-1976, XLI, Western Europe; NATO, 1969-1972: Sources
exercise: Start with RG 46, then identify the committee and series. Consult the Center for Legislative Archives at Archives I.

name: Carl Marcy Papers, Box 8
level: Files within the committee Records of the Chairman, RG 46
description: A FRUS annotation cites a copy of an April 22 letter concerning Spanish base negotiations.
exercise: Follow RG 46 > Senate Foreign Relations Committee > Records of the Chairman > Carl Marcy Papers > Box 8.
